In reply to this message
Usage: /c SYMBOL[,SYMBOL…] [INTERVAL] [FLAGS]

Intervals
1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 12h, 1d, 1w

Overlays
sr — support / resistance bands
vp — volume profile (VPVR) + POC / value area
pday — previous-day H / L / C
ses — NY / EU / Asia session shading
avwap — anchored VWAP (from window start)
vwaph — anchored VWAP from the swing high
<wallet> — paste a wallet address to mark its buys/sells
fib — Fibonacci retracement
fiblh — Fibonacci anchored on the last swing leg
% — swing % moves (legs ≥3% labeled; use %5 for 5% floor)
mas — moving averages (EMA21 · SMA50 · SMA200)
emaN, smaN — custom MAs (e.g. ema50 sma25; up to 5)
rsi — RSI oscillator pane (use rsi21 for a custom length)
macd — MACD pane (12/26/9): MACD + signal lines and a green/red histogram
smc — smart-money concepts: fair-value gaps, order blocks, BOS / CHoCH
gap — gap-fill breakouts: FVG boxes that shrink as they fill + breakout arrows
adr — 14-day average daily range: projected high / open / low + range-used % (use adr7 for a custom length)
st — SuperTrend: ATR trend line, green below price (up) / red above (down), flips on a break
bb — Bollinger Bands: 20-period SMA + upper/lower bands at ±2σ (volatility envelope)
oi — aggregated open interest (total perp OI, notional $) + this feed's funding rate & trend ribbon
liq — aggregated liquidations: long (red, down) vs short (green, up) forced $ per bar
lsr — long/short accounts ratio: crowd positioning line (>1 = net long, <1 = net short)
mc — market-cap scale
nv — hide the volume band
fchm — first-call heatmap
w — wide chart

Feeds
SYMBOL — auto: Hyperliquid if listed (SOL, BTC, TSLA, GOLD…), else on-chain DEX
:dex force on-chain · :hl Hyperliquid · :bn Binance · :bb Bybit · :okx OKX · :kr Kraken · :ub Upbit · :t TradFi/Stocks

Prediction Markets
Paste a Polymarket or Kalshi event link to chart its outcome odds over time. Reply / tweet timestamps work too — each outcome shows its odds move since (see Timestamp).

Timestamp
Reply to any message — or include an X (tweet) or Truth Social post link — to pin the chart at that moment and show the move since. Works on coin and prediction-market charts.

Examples
/c BTC 1h
/c ETH 4h ema50 sma25
/c SOL avwap sr
/c BTC 1d oi — open interest + funding
/c BNB adr gap rsi — ADR + gap-fill + RSI
/c WIF 0x67…UAsg — a wallet's buys / sells on the chart
/c BTC 1d % — swing % moves
/c BTC,SOL,ETH — compare up to 8 coins
/c BTC/ETH 1h — ratio candles (base ÷ quote)
/c TSLA 1d — stocks / commodities
/c BTC:bn 4h sr — Binance feed
/c AAPL:t 1d — Yahoo Finance (stocks, FX, futures)
/c polymarket.com/event/… — Polymarket / Kalshi odds
/c BTC (reply to a message) — % since that timestamp
/c SOL + a tweet / Truth Social link — % since that post
